lines.en: My little legs move very fast.
I follow the mycelium to find food.
Every step ends in a little hop.
I walk along carrying an empty bowl.
That chest up ahead smells of something.

lines.zh: 我拖着比我还大的影子。
lines.en: I drag a shadow bigger than myself.
My ankles are thin as twigs.

lines.zh: 我边跑边咬自己的袖子。
lines.en: I run along biting my own sleeve.
Your legs are long; mine are tiny.
I can smell bread somewhere nearby.
I am heading to that kitchen first.
Every three steps, I must catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来啃自己的指甲。
lines.en: I squat down and gnaw my own nails.
I am counting the mushrooms on the wall.
My stomach squeaks like a small animal.
I lick the mycelium off my lips.
Where are the grown ones? I look around.
I pick mycelium off the hem of my shirt.
A bug crawls by; I pinch it dead.
I try standing the way the grown ones do.
I burp a little, and spores come out.
I hug my knees and rock back and forth.
The quiet makes me uncomfortable.
I wait for someone to open a cupboard.
My hands are always damp.
I put my fingers into my mouth.

lines.zh: 我趴在箱子边，听里面有没有响。
lines.en: I lie by the chest, listening for a sound inside.

lines.zh: 我把脸贴在冰凉的柜门上。
lines.en: I press my face to the cold cupboard door.

lines.zh: 我在学怎么把手指掰响。
lines.en: I am learning to crack my knuckles.

lines.zh: 屋角有只老鼠，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: A rat in the corner; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 你口袋里是不是有吃的。
lines.en: Is there food in your pocket?
Your hands are three times bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 仰头太久，我脖子咔一声。
lines.en: Looking up too long, my neck clicks.
Will you give me a bit of bread?
Your legs look rather tasty.
I tilt my head, waiting for you to crouch.
There are wheat grains on your sleeve.
I blink; my eyes are very dry.

lines.zh: 你手里那个东西能吃吗。
lines.en: Can I eat the thing in your hand?
I cannot reach as high as your shoulder.
You bend down, and I smile.
Your shadow is even bigger than the chest.
You hit my head, and it hurts.
I fall down and get up again.
My armor is a single layer of skin.
Your blows land much harder than mine.
I curl up, but my teeth still show.
Pain makes me hiss like a leaking bellows.
I have only twelve points of life.
Blood and mycelium run down together.
You strike a child; have you no shame?
I can still manage one more bite.
Bread, real bread, I can smell it.
I smell cooked meat, warm and close.
Just a small piece; I will not bite you.

lines.zh: 那个篮子里装的是什么。
lines.en: What is inside that basket you carry?
I follow food, not people.
My teeth have grown quite sharp already.
Take it out, and I will be quiet.
Sugar or bread, which one is sweeter?

lines.zh: 你背后藏着什么，我闻见了。
lines.en: I smell what you are hiding behind your back.
I rise on tiptoe to reach your hand.
You knock me over and I roll once.
I am small, but I bite accurately.
Do not step on me; my bones are brittle.
I grab hold of your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 你推我一下，我记你一天。
lines.en: One push from you, and I remember a day.

lines.zh: 我从你膝弯底下拱出去。
lines.en: I wriggle out under your knee.
That hurt; I will bite back for it.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀还没你膝盖高。
lines.en: My shoulder is lower than your knee.
Hold still; I cannot keep my balance.
I bump you and land on my backside.
We must find the fungal mother together.

lines.zh: 两只小的挤在一起取暖。
lines.en: Two little ones huddle together for warmth.

lines.zh: 你的菌丝缠上我的手指。
lines.en: Your mycelium wraps around my fingers.
We split one piece of bread between us.
I was infected three days before you.
Where will we go once we grow up?
Your legs are longer; wait for me.

lines.zh: 我们的孢子会飘到很远。
lines.en: Our spores will drift very far.
We crouch side by side, gnawing on something.
Do not leave me behind; I will cry.
There is half a loaf on the ground.
I pick it up and brush off the dust.
I will hide this piece of iron.

lines.zh: 我口袋里已经有三颗种子。
lines.en: I already have three seeds in my pocket.
Found it; I will eat it right away.
I cannot carry all of this.
Dropped food always belongs to me.
I sniff it first, then take a bite.
I stuff it inside my collar.
Who dropped this? Did you ask me?

lines.zh: 你手里拿着吃的，就是目标。
lines.en: You are holding food, so you are my target.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你腰上的袋子。
lines.en: I have my eye on your belt pouch.
That person has their back to the chest.
You are a little easier to chew than the chest.
You crouched, and now you're just the right height to bite.
You have an open wound; perfect.
I pick the one standing alone first.
You are limping a little.

lines.zh: 你蹲下的那一刻最好咬。
lines.en: The moment you crouch is the best time to bite.

lines.zh: 你看起来像会给我吃的。
lines.en: You look like someone who feeds me.
I crouch low, waiting for one more step.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬下去会留菌丝。
lines.en: My bite will leave mycelium behind.
Ten seconds until your leg starts itching.
I count your toes to pick my spot.
When you raise your foot, I dodge.

lines.zh: 我躲进箱子后面绕过去。
lines.en: I hide behind the chest and circle around.
One bite, and thirty seconds will do.
I wait for your hand to drop lower.
Do not look at me; it will not help.
I am close now, and you have not noticed.
I have bitten into your ankle.
My teeth are short, but I bite hard.

lines.zh: 三十秒后你会开始难受。
lines.en: In thirty seconds you will start to feel it.

lines.zh: 我抓出一道浅浅的口子。
lines.en: I scratch out a shallow red line.
You jump with pain, and I laugh.
Mycelium is stuck between my teeth.
I bite once and then back away.
Kick me and I bite your boot.
The infection will grow on its own.
I have no strength, but my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 我从一具小身体里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a small dead body.
The grown one died; I stayed behind.

lines.zh: 菌丝把我拼成了一个孩子。
lines.en: Mycelium pieced me into a child.
I opened my eyes and was already hungry.

lines.zh: 我的衣服是别人留下的。
lines.en: These clothes were left by someone else.

lines.zh: 我原来的名字记不清了。
lines.en: I cannot clearly recall my old name.
The village is empty; I wander inside it.
I am small enough to slip through gaps.
I understand everything you say.
I have not had my first bite.

lines.zh: 我的第一声是哭还是咳。
lines.en: Was my first sound a cry or a cough?
Do not be afraid; I am not tall.

lines.zh: 火一碰我，我就缩成一粒。
lines.en: One touch of fire and I curl up small.

lines.zh: 我从箱子上摔下来，磕到牙。
lines.en: I fall off the chest and knock a tooth.
Water reaches my chin; I keep grabbing.
The blast throws me into the corner.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的袖子，钉在墙上。
lines.en: An arrow goes through my sleeve into the wall.

lines.zh: 魔法把我举起来，我乱踢。
lines.en: Magic lifts me up and I kick wildly.
Hunger makes me bite my own fingers.

lines.zh: 雷把我的头发竖起来了。
lines.en: Lightning stands my hair straight up.

lines.zh: 虚空里什么都没有，连味道都没有。
lines.en: The void has nothing, not even a smell.
